name: inclusion_bodies
description: Inclusion-body accumulation across a growing colony.

_contract.summary: Colony growth + division + inclusion-body burden — combines cell growth with an IB load that slows growth as it accumulates.

outputs.agents: Cells grown (rate 1/s → floor) with IB burden (ib_burden_coef) up to ib_max (nm); division splits at length threshold (µm).

assumptions: Growth rate falls with IB load; pressure-modulated by `pressure_k`.

_contract.summary: 2D rigid-body physics for the colony — steps a pymunk space so cells grow, push apart, and reorient under collisions, damping, and jitter.

inputs.segment_cells: Rod-shaped rigid cells — per cell: location (µm), length (µm), radius (µm), mass (pg), angle (rad), velocity (µm/s).
inputs.bending_cells: Soft multi-segment capsule cells joined by rotary springs — per cell: location (µm), length (µm), radius (µm), mass (pg), angle (rad), velocity (µm/s).
inputs.circle_particles: Circular particles (e.g. EPS) — location (µm), radius (µm), mass (pg).

outputs.segment_cells: Rod cells after one physics step — position (µm) / angle (rad) advanced by forces + collisions.
outputs.bending_cells: Bending cells after one physics step (segment poses updated).

assumptions: Overdamped motion (velocity damping/s, gravity off by default); `substeps` sub-steps per update; rectangular chamber of side env_size (µm) with walls of wall_thickness (µm).

_contract.summary: Contact-pressure from neighbor + wall overlap — computes a per-cell mechanical pressure used to modulate growth in dense colonies.

inputs.agents: Cells; per cell: location (µm), length (µm), radius (µm), mass (pg), angle (rad), velocity (µm/s) (overlap from radius/length µm).

outputs.agents: Cells annotated with local pressure (scaled by `pressure_scale`), from neighbor contacts + walls at env_size (µm).

assumptions: Pressure ∝ pairwise overlap depth (µm) minus `contact_slack`; walls weighted by `wall_weight`.
